# Skribly

> Skribly is a non-commercial ecosystem of developer tools: an issue tracker, a desktop environment for AI agents and a library of agent skills.

Skribly is a non-commercial project by Dawid Olko, Piotr Smoła, Michał Pilecki, Konrad Pluta and Mateusz Olko. The repositories are private for now. Every page is also available in Polish under /pl/.

## Apps

- [Apps](https://skribly.pl/apps/): Skribly Agent, Skribly Tracker and agent-skills: what each app does and how they work together.
- [Download](https://agent.skribly.pl/download/): Download Skribly Agent for macOS, Windows and Linux. Installers update on their own, and each release lists SHA-256 checksums.
- [Skribly Agent](https://skribly.pl/apps/skribly-agent/): A desktop environment for AI coding agents on macOS, Windows and Linux: tasks, Git worktrees, pipelines and audits.
- [Skribly Tracker](https://skribly.pl/apps/skribly-tracker/): An issue tracker in the browser with Kanban boards, time logs and a REST API that agents can use.
- [agent-skills](https://skribly.pl/apps/agent-skills/): 39 portable skills with one installer for seven AI coding agents, from a tracker ticket to a reviewed, tested commit.

## Product

- [Features](https://skribly.pl/features/): Everything in Skribly Agent, Skribly Tracker and agent-skills, grouped by job: running agents, tasks, review, audits and more.
- [Integrations](https://skribly.pl/integrations/): Support tables for 13 AI coding agents, six issue trackers, Git hosts, editors, MCP servers and audit tools.
- [Skills catalogue](https://skribly.pl/skills/): All 39 agent skills with a description and category each: workflow, tests, performance, security, docs and more.
- [Agents or terminals](https://skribly.pl/compare/): What Skribly Agent adds to plain terminals and multiplexers like tmux, and when a multiplexer is the better fit.
- [Changelog](https://skribly.pl/changelog/): What changed in Skribly Agent, Skribly Tracker and agent-skills, rewritten in plain words from the GitHub release notes.
- [Roadmap](https://skribly.pl/roadmap/): What is finished in Skribly, what comes next and what is still missing, taken from the project's own documentation.
